general.imageCompressionQualityHelp: JPEG compression quality (0.1-1.0). Default is 0.8 to reduce file size when transmitting images to AI models, as we don't compress images during API transmission which could result in large file sizes.
general.imageMaxWidthHelp: Maximum width for image resizing. Images exceeding this width will be proportionally scaled down. Set to 0 for no size limit. This feature exists because some AI models may have limitations when processing very large images. However, most AI models can handle images automatically, so the default is 0 (no restriction) to preserve your original images.

asr.positiveSpeechThresholdDesc: Minimum confidence level (1-100) required to detect speech. Higher values reduce false positives
asr.negativeSpeechThresholdDesc: Confidence level (0-100) below which speech detection stops. Lower values make detection less sensitive
asr.redemptionFramesDesc: Number of consecutive frames (1-100) needed to confirm speech detection. Higher values reduce noise triggers

kid.lesson1QuizDesc: Learn to recognize Happy, Sad, Angry through facial expressions with Momo.
kid.lesson1Scenario: Momo is smiling brightly with squinted eyes and waving hello like this. Can you guess how Momo is feeling?
kid.lesson1Opt1: Momo is very Happy and Joyful
kid.lesson1Opt2: Momo is Sad and wants to cry
kid.lesson1Opt3: Momo is Angry and wants to shout
kid.lesson1Feedback: That's correct! Great job! When smiling happily, we open our hearts and are full of positive energy! 🌟
kid.lesson2QuizDesc: What to do when a friend accidentally breaks a toy? Learn empathetic responses.
kid.lesson2Scenario: Friend Bin accidentally stepped on the clay model Momo just sculpted, flattening it. What should you do to resolve this conflict?
kid.lesson2Opt1: Scream at your friend, push them down, and demand a new model
kid.lesson2Opt2: Take a deep breath to calm down, listen to your friend's apology, and sculpt a new model together
kid.lesson2Opt3: Cry and throw a tantrum, telling parents to punish friend Bin
kid.lesson2Feedback: Wonderful! You know how to stay calm and forgive. Repairing mistakes together makes friendships stronger! 💖
kid.lesson3QuizDesc: How children create safety feelings and bravely face fear of the dark.
kid.lesson3Scenario: At night when lights turn off for sleep, the pitch-black room makes you feel worried and scared of monsters. What will you do to bravely overcome this fear?
kid.lesson3Opt1: Pull blanket over your head and weep silently all night
kid.lesson3Opt2: Scream loudly calling parents to come sleep together
kid.lesson3Opt3: Hug plushie Momo snugly, breathe steadily, and think of sweet candy dreamland
kid.lesson3Feedback: That's right! A plush toy and positive thoughts are brave medicine chasing away darkness for peaceful sleep! 😴

kid.modeScenario1: Momo is smiling brightly with squinted eyes and waving hello like this. Can you guess how Momo is feeling?
kid.modeScenario2: You finished drawing a very beautiful picture, but your friend accidentally spilled water smudging it. What should you do in this situation?
kid.modeScenario2OptA: 😡 Get angry, shout at friend, and tear friend's drawing
kid.modeScenario2OptB: 😢 Cry out loud then run to tell parents/teacher immediately
kid.modeScenario2OptC: 🗣️ Calmly say: Please be careful next time, then invite friend to draw together again
kid.modeScenario2Feedback: Wonderful! You behaved very empathetically and bravely. Sharing feelings peacefully makes friendships stronger! 🤝
kid.modeScenario2Wrong: Doing so may frighten your friend and escalate conflict. Try choosing another smart solution!
kid.modeScenario3: When parents turn off bedroom lights, surrounding darkness makes you feel slightly scared. Which action helps you stay calm and braver?
kid.modeScenario3OptA: 🧸 Hug plushie tightly, close eyes and take 3 deep breaths
kid.modeScenario3OptB: 😱 Pull blanket completely over head and weep anxiously
kid.modeScenario3OptC: 🚪 Fling open door and run over demanding parents turn lights bright
kid.modeScenario3Feedback: Excellent! Deep breathing and hugging your favorite item signals your brain that you are safe. Sweet dreams! 🧸
kid.modeScenario3Wrong: Pulling blanket over head can make you feel more suffocated and afraid. Try a body-calming solution!
